gen-gf-autour-one-gf-geom: Round, loud and unmistakably display: Autour One draws its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, with a clear channel leading into every bowl. Geom sits beneath it as a sans with a lofty lowercase band.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hammersmith-one: Autour One leads with a minimal step from capitals to lowercase and no hairline-to-stem shifts anywhere in its round letters. Hammersmith One follows in plain sans, its cord-like strokes making a long page feel smooth.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-inder: Bold and expressive, Autour One draws in a single-weight line like a plotter pen, with little step between its cases. Its heading shapes handle the shouting; Inder, a low-key sans-serif, handles the sentences.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-jaldi: Autour One bends every letter like a paperclip, with no thick-to-thin shifts at all. Jaldi follows in a plain sans with an x-height pushed high, so give it a modest size and let it breathe.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Kdam Thmor Pro reads modern, with bowls that fill the line. Paragraphs in it feel dense and confident, while Autour One adds bowls as heavy as its stems above.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-krona-one: Autour One holds each stroke to one thickness, like a drawn cable, with a clear channel into every round letter. Krona One answers in a sans with loosely spaced letters and a lowercase as stately as cast iron capitals, which makes the pairing feel wonderfully sturdy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-magra: Magra brings a big-bodied feel to every lowercase word, a sans-serif that fills its space. And Autour One, with wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine, gives the pair a confident, expressive character.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-major-mono-display: Precise and technical, Major Mono Display glows with tube-like strokes and big sidebearings, a monospace that sweeps its curves open. Autour One adds a bolder voice above it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-martian-mono: Structured, loose and code-minded, Autour One's heading sits above a body with a clear channel into each round letter. Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width letters and generous curve openings, keeps each line ticking along like a typewriter.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-matemasie: Expressive open shapes in Autour One lead the way here. Matemasie, a sans with broad gaps and small entries into closed round letters, handles the quiet running text.
